title: Agent
subtitle: Look at the map together and fix your document folder
unsupported: This answer was made without reading the folder. Do not take it as fact.
boundary: Work that needs your source code is better done by the AI in your own terminal. Here the agent only reads your document folder.
handoffNote: Copy this and paste it into your own terminal. You run it: this app never types commands for you.

scope.title: Before anything is sent
scope.body: In this conversation the agent reads your document folder as it works. What it reads goes to {provider} ({host}) each time.
scope.liveRows: Every read shows up as its own line here, with how many characters went out.
scope.recorded: Every round trip is recorded in {path}.
scope.consent: If a document needs changing, you see the exact edit first and approve it before it is saved.

promptDisclosure.summary: See the instructions the agent receives
promptDisclosure.note: The text below is sent every time. You cannot edit it, but you can always read it.

proposal.title: Proposal · {count} file(s) to change
proposal.snapshotUnavailable: This folder is not a git repository, so no checkpoint can be made
proposal.conflict: This document just changed: nothing was written. Please ask again.
proposal.failed: The apply failed: {message} Files may have partially changed. Check the document, then ask again.
proposal.unreadWarning: This would change a file the agent did not read in this conversation. Expand it and check.
proposal.partialWrites: Confirmed saved files before the failure: {paths}.
proposal.refreshFailed: The folder could not be reloaded: {message}. Inspect the saved files before retrying.

notice.roundCap: That is as far as I will go: wrapping up.
notice.timedOut: The model did not answer within the time limit. Narrow the question or try a faster model.
notice.rateLimited: You have hit the rate limit for now. Try again shortly.
notice.rejected: The key was rejected. Check it in Agents → Models.
notice.auditBlocked: Nothing was sent, because the record could not be written.
notice.noToolCall: The agent stopped at attempt {round} of {cap} without reading this folder even once. Try asking again.

degraded.webTitle: Available in the desktop app only
degraded.webBody: A browser has nowhere safe to keep your key. In the desktop app it stays in this computer’s operating-system credential store.
degraded.noVaultBody: The agent only reads documents in the folder you have open. Pick a folder and this picks up right here.
degraded.noKeyTitle: This needs an AI service key, once
degraded.noKeyBody: The key stays in this computer's keychain only. Register it once and this spot connects right away, and you are not asked again. If you already use Claude Code or Codex, no key is needed: connect that tool from the Agents destination on the left.

locked.consentPromise: If a document needs changing, you see the exact edit first. Nothing on disk changes until you say so.

firstWords.title: Where would you like to start?
firstWords.hint: Tap one and the sentence lands in the box below. Edit it before sending
firstWords.missingDefinition: Nobody has written down what "{title}" means. Draft it for me
firstWords.missingDomain: "{title}" is not filed under any group yet. Find where it belongs
firstWords.missingRelations: Check whether "{title}" is missing any links
firstWords.mapReview: What looks most wrong on this map right now?
firstWords.emptyVault: This folder is still empty. Help me work out what this product is first

footerDetail: {chars} characters were exchanged this turn. Most of it is instructions you never see.

reground.title: Stopped at attempt {round} of {cap}. Have it re-read this folder and answer again

construction.boundary: This conversation reads your document folder. Build from code reads a code folder you choose with your local model.
construction.webUnavailable: Build from code is available in the macOS app with a local model. Open your document folder there to continue.
construction.preparing: Checking the selected folder… No code has been sent to the model.
construction.previewTitle: Before your local model reads code
construction.scope: Run sends code excerpts from this folder to the local model at the address shown. Your document folder is excluded from code reads. Code stays read-only. Only document changes you review and approve can be saved.
construction.inventoryLimited: The folder check reached its limit. This list is incomplete; choose a narrower folder or run with the files found.
construction.localRequired: Build from code needs a local model at an address on this computer. Choose one in Agents → Models, then try again.
construction.empty: No supported code files were found outside your document folder. Choose another code folder.
construction.sourceChanged: The selected code folder or its evidence changed or cannot be read. Choose the folder and run again before applying a draft.
construction.incomplete: Construction stopped before finishing. This draft covers only the evidence read; review its gaps or choose a narrower folder.
construction.failed: The local model did not finish a draft. Check the model connection and retry; your folder selection and input are kept.
construction.draft: Draft from selected code. review its evidence and unknowns before applying.
